30 
31     Creates the following filesystem structure for the session storage:
32     ```bash
33     /<sessions_dir>/
34     └── session_<session_id>/
35         ├── session.json                # Session metadata
36         └── agents/
37             └── agent_<agent_id>/
38                 ├── agent.json          # Agent metadata
39                 └── messages/
40                     ├── message_<id1>.json
41                     └── message_<id2>.json
42     ```
43     """
44

75             # Append 'strands-agents' to existing user_agent_extra or set it if not present
76             if existing_user_agent:

133     def _read_s3_object(self, key: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
134         """Read JSON object from S3."""
135         try:
136             response = self.client.get_object(Bucket=self.bucket, Key=key)

167     def _fix_broken_tool_use(self, messages: list[Message]) -> list[Message]:
168         """Add tool_result after orphaned tool_use messages.
169 
170         Before 1.15.0, strands had a bug where they persisted sessions with a potentially broken messages array.
171         This method retroactively fixes that issue by adding a tool_result outside of session management. After 1.15.0,
172         this bug is no longer present.
173         """
174         for index, message in enumerate(messages):
175             # Check all but the latest message in the messages array
176             # The latest message being orphaned is handled in the agent class
177             if index + 1 < len(messages):
178                 if any("toolUse" in content for content in message["content"]):
179                     tool_use_ids = [
180                         content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"] for content in message["content"] if "toolUse" in content
181                     ]
182 
183                     # Check if there are more messages after the current toolUse message
184                     tool_result_ids = [
185                         content["toolResult"]["toolUseId"]
186                         for content in messages[index + 1]["content"]
187                         if "toolResult" in content
188                     ]
189 
190                     missing_tool_use_ids = list(set(tool_use_ids) - set(tool_result_ids))
191                     # If there area missing tool use ids, that means the messages history is broken
192                     if missing_tool_use_ids:
193                         logger.warning(
194                             "Session message history has an orphaned toolUse with no toolResult. "
195                             "Adding toolResult content blocks to create valid conversation."
196                         )
197                         # Create the missing toolResult content blocks
198                         missing_content_blocks = generate_missing_tool_result_content(missing_tool_use_ids)
199 
200                         if tool_result_ids:
201                             # If there were any toolResult ids, that means only some of the content blocks are missing
202                             messages[index + 1]["content"].extend(missing_content_blocks)
203                         else:
204                             # The message following the toolUse was not a toolResult, so lets insert it
205                             messages.insert(index + 1, {"role": "user", "content": missing_content_blocks})
206         return messages

30     def __init__(
31         self,
32         session_id: str,
33         session_repository: SessionRepository,
34         **kwargs: Any,
35     ):
36         """Initialize the RepositorySessionManager.
37 
38         If no session with the specified session_id exists yet, it will be created
39         in the session_repository.
40 
41         Args:
42             session_id: ID to use for the session. A new session with this id will be created if it does
43                 not exist in the repository yet
44             session_repository: Underlying session repository to use to store the sessions state.
45             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
46 
47         """
48         self.session_repository = session_repository
49         self.session_id = session_id
50         session = session_repository.read_session(session_id)
51         # Create a session if it does not exist yet
52         if session is None:
53             logger.debug("session_id=<%s> | session not found, creating new session", self.session_id)
54             session = Session(session_id=session_id, session_type=SessionType.AGENT)
55             session_repository.create_session(session)
56 
57         self.session = session
58 
59         # Keep track of the latest message of each agent in case we need to redact it.
60         self._latest_agent_message: dict[str, Optional[SessionMessage]] = {}
61 
62     def append_message(self, message: Message, agent: "Agent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
63         """Append a message to the agent's session.
64 
65         Args:
66             message: Message to add to the agent in the session
67             agent: Agent to append the message to
68             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
69         """
70         # Calculate the next index (0 if this is the first message, otherwise increment the previous index)
71         latest_agent_message = self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id]
72         if latest_agent_message:
73             next_index = latest_agent_message.message_id + 1
74         else:
75             next_index = 0
76 
77         session_message = SessionMessage.from_message(message, next_index)
78         self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_message
79         self.session_repository.create_message(self.session_id, agent.agent_id, session_message)
80

83 
84         Args:
85             redact_message: New message to use that contains the redact content
86             agent: Agent to apply the message redaction to
87             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
88         """
89         latest_agent_message = self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id]
90         if latest_agent_message is None:
91             raise SessionException("No message to redact.")
92         latest_agent_message.redact_message = redact_message
93         return self.session_repository.update_message(self.session_id, agent.agent_id, latest_agent_message)
94 
95     def sync_agent(self, agent: "Agent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
96         """Serialize and update the agent into the session repository.
97 
98         Args:
99             agent: Agent to sync to the session.
100             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
101         """
102         self.session_repository.update_agent(
103             self.session_id,
104             SessionAgent.from_agent(agent),
105         )

107     def initialize(self, agent: "Agent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
108         """Initialize an agent with a session.
109 
110         Args:
111             agent: Agent to initialize from the session
112             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
113         """
114         if agent.agent_id in self._latest_agent_message:
115             raise SessionException("The `agent_id` of an agent must be unique in a session.")
116         self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = None
117 
118         session_agent = self.session_repository.read_agent(self.session_id, agent.agent_id)
119 
120         if session_agent is None:
121             logger.debug(
122                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | creating agent",
123                 agent.agent_id,
124                 self.session_id,
125             )
126 
127             session_agent = SessionAgent.from_agent(agent)
128             self.session_repository.create_agent(self.session_id, session_agent)
129             # Initialize messages with sequential indices
130             session_message = None
131             for i, message in enumerate(agent.messages):
132                 session_message = SessionMessage.from_message(message, i)
133                 self.session_repository.create_message(self.session_id, agent.agent_id, session_message)
134             self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_message
135         else:
136             logger.debug(
137                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | restoring agent",
138                 agent.agent_id,
139                 self.session_id,
140             )
141             agent.state = AgentState(session_agent.state)
142 
143             session_agent.initialize_internal_state(agent)
144 
145             # Restore the conversation manager to its previous state, and get the optional prepend messages
146             prepend_messages = agent.conversation_manager.restore_from_session(session_agent.conversation_manager_state)
147 
148             if prepend_messages is None:
149                 prepend_messages = []
150 
151             # List the messages currently in the session, using an offset of the messages previously removed
152             # by the conversation manager.
153             session_messages = self.session_repository.list_messages(
154                 session_id=self.session_id,
155                 agent_id=agent.agent_id,
156                 offset=agent.conversation_manager.removed_message_count,
157             )
158             if len(session_messages) > 0:
159                 self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_messages[-1]
160 
161             # Restore the agents messages array including the optional prepend messages
162             agent.messages = prepend_messages + [session_message.to_message() for session_message in session_messages]
163 
164             # Fix broken session histories: https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/859
165             agent.messages = self._fix_broken_tool_use(agent.messages)

197                         # Create the missing toolResult content blocks
198                         missing_content_blocks = generate_missing_tool_result_content(missing_tool_use_ids)
199 
200                         if tool_result_ids:
201                             # If there were any toolResult ids, that means only some of the content blocks are missing
202                             messages[index + 1]["content"].extend(missing_content_blocks)
203                         else:
204                             # The message following the toolUse was not a toolResult, so lets insert it
205                             messages.insert(index + 1, {"role": "user", "content": missing_content_blocks})
206         return messages

231     def initialize_bidi_agent(self, agent: "BidiAgent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
232         """Initialize a bidirectional agent with a session.
233 
234         Args:
235             agent: BidiAgent to initialize from the session
236             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
237         """
238         if agent.agent_id in self._latest_agent_message:
239             raise SessionException("The `agent_id` of an agent must be unique in a session.")
240         self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = None
241 
242         session_agent = self.session_repository.read_agent(self.session_id, agent.agent_id)
243 
244         if session_agent is None:
245             logger.debug(
246                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | creating bidi agent",
247                 agent.agent_id,
248                 self.session_id,
249             )
250 
251             session_agent = SessionAgent.from_bidi_agent(agent)
252             self.session_repository.create_agent(self.session_id, session_agent)
253             # Initialize messages with sequential indices
254             session_message = None
255             for i, message in enumerate(agent.messages):
256                 session_message = SessionMessage.from_message(message, i)
257                 self.session_repository.create_message(self.session_id, agent.agent_id, session_message)
258             self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_message
259         else:
260             logger.debug(
261                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | restoring bidi agent",
262                 agent.agent_id,
263                 self.session_id,
264             )
265             agent.state = AgentState(session_agent.state)
266 
267             session_agent.initialize_bidi_internal_state(agent)
268 
269             # BidiAgent has no conversation_manager, so no prepend_messages or removed_message_count
270             session_messages = self.session_repository.list_messages(
271                 session_id=self.session_id,
272                 agent_id=agent.agent_id,
273                 offset=0,
274             )
275             if len(session_messages) > 0:
276                 self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_messages[-1]
277 
278             # Restore the agents messages array
279             agent.messages = [session_message.to_message() for session_message in session_messages]
280 
281             # Fix broken session histories: https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/859
282             agent.messages = self._fix_broken_tool_use(agent.messages)
283 
284     def append_bidi_message(self, message: Message, agent: "BidiAgent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
285         """Append a message to the bidirectional agent's session.
286 
287         Args:
288             message: Message to add to the agent in the session
289             agent: BidiAgent to append the message to
290             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
291         """
292         # Calculate the next index (0 if this is the first message, otherwise increment the previous index)
293         latest_agent_message = self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id]
294         if latest_agent_message:
295             next_index = latest_agent_message.message_id + 1
296         else:
297             next_index = 0
298 
299         session_message = SessionMessage.from_message(message, next_index)
300         self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_message
301         self.session_repository.create_message(self.session_id, agent.agent_id, session_message)
